# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (MIDDLE). Generated by gen_territory_middle.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ======================== ladder bookkeeping ========================
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action below). Months as a provincialised subject (oe_tm_sub2_months) and months in a row
# with an opinion of BYZ below 0 (oe_tm_neg_months); the delay earned as an ally does not carry over a promotion.
oe_tm_monthly = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_sub2_months value = 0 }
            remove_variable = oe_tm_ladder_extra
        }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tm_sub2_months add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_neg_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_neg_months value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tm_neg_months add = 1 }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = oe_tm_neg_months }
    }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II } OR = { has_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months has_variable = oe_tm_neg_months } }
        remove_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months
        remove_variable = oe_tm_neg_months
    }
    # One demotion event at a time; the mark lapses after 3 months if the event never resolves.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_dem_open } any_subject = { oe_tm_demote_due = yes } }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_tm_demote_due = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tm_dem }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_dem_open value = scope:oe_tm_dem months = 3 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tm.3
    }
}
# Subject scope. Back to the Roman alliance; the ladder starts again (no integration for 10 years).
oe_tm_demote = {
    change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub
    remove_variable = oe_tm_sub2_months
    remove_variable = oe_tm_neg_months
    remove_variable = oe_tm_ladder_extra
    set_variable = { name = oe_tm_demote_cd years = 10 }
}

# ======================== provincialisation (设省) ========================
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tm_req = the subject. Pays the Authority and puts the issue to the senate (track SENATE).
# The pending mark lapses after 12 months in case the vote never comes back.
oe_tm_request = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -10 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tm_target value = scope:oe_tm_req }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tm_pending value = scope:oe_tm_req months = 12 }
	    oe_tsn_request = { issue = 3 }
	}
}
# BYZ scope. Contract: the senate passed (or the emperor forced) issue 3.
oe_tsn_apply_3 = {
    custom_tooltip = oe_tm_apply_3_tt
    hidden_effect = {
        remove_variable = oe_tm_pending
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_target var:oe_tm_target ?= { is_subject_of = c:BYZ any_owned_location = { count >= 1 } } }
            var:oe_tm_target = { save_scope_as = oe_tm_sub }
            oe_tm_provincialise = yes
        }
        remove_variable = oe_tm_target
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Contract: the senate dropped issue 3.
oe_tsn_reject_3 = {
    custom_tooltip = oe_tm_reject_3_tt
    hidden_effect = {
        remove_variable = oe_tm_pending
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_target var:oe_tm_target ?= { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } }
            var:oe_tm_target = {
                save_scope_as = oe_tm_rej
                set_variable = { name = oe_tm_prov_cd years = 5 }
            }
            reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tm_prov_rejected target = scope:oe_tm_rej }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_rej_last value = scope:oe_tm_rej }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tm.2
        }
        remove_variable = oe_tm_target
    }
}

# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tm_sub = the subject. Annex it and turn its land into 1-3 provinces.
oe_tm_provincialise = {
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_1
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_2
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_3
    remove_variable = oe_tm_old_ruler
    # Seats: the most populous location; with 12+ locations also the most populous one in another area; with 30+
    # a third in yet another area. Saved before the annexation (location scopes outlive the country).
    scope:oe_tm_sub = { ordered_owned_location = { order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat1 } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_tm_seat1
            scope:oe_tm_sub = {
                any_owned_location = { count >= 12 }
                any_owned_location = { NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat1.area } }
            }
        }
        scope:oe_tm_sub = {
            ordered_owned_location = { limit = { NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat1.area } } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat2 }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_tm_seat2
            scope:oe_tm_sub = {
                any_owned_location = { count >= 30 }
                any_owned_location = { NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat1.area } NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat2.area } }
            }
        }
        scope:oe_tm_sub = {
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat1.area } NOT = { area = scope:oe_tm_seat2.area } }
                order_by = population
                save_scope_as = oe_tm_seat3
            }
        }
    }
    scope:oe_tm_sub = {
        ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tm_old_king }
        every_owned_location = { set_variable = oe_tm_land }
    }
    annex_country_diplomatically = { country = scope:oe_tm_sub }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_seat1 scope:oe_tm_seat1 = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        oe_tm_found_1 = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_new_1 value = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_seat2 scope:oe_tm_seat2 = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
            oe_tm_found_2 = yes
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_new_2 value = scope:oe_tm_th2 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_seat3 scope:oe_tm_seat3 = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
            oe_tm_found_3 = yes
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_new_3 value = scope:oe_tm_th3 }
        }
        # Jurisdiction: every former location goes to the nearest seat.
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_land }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } if = { limit = { oe_tm_d2 < oe_tm_d1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 2 } } }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } if = { limit = { oe_tm_d3 < oe_tm_d1 oe_tm_d3 < oe_tm_d2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_to value = 3 } } }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_to ?= 3 exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } oe_tm_post = { n = 3 } }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_to ?= 2 exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } oe_tm_post = { n = 2 } }
            else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 } oe_tm_post = { n = 1 } }
            remove_variable = oe_tm_to
            remove_variable = oe_tm_land
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th1 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th2 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_th3 } oe_tm_set_new_status = { n = 3 } }
        # The former ruler waits at court for the emperor's choice (oe_tm.1).
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_old_king scope:oe_tm_old_king = { is_alive = yes is_adult = yes } }
            scope:oe_tm_old_king = { move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tm_old_ruler value = scope:oe_tm_old_king }
        }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tm.1
    }
    else = {
        # The annexation did not happen: leave the land unmarked.
        scope:oe_tm_sub ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_land } remove_variable = oe_tm_land } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Founds province $n$ at scope:oe_tm_seat$n$ as scope:oe_tm_th$n$: same steps as oe_theme_found_at_seat
# (gen_theme_setup.py) with the army course; the jurisdiction comes from oe_tm_post instead of a historical region.
oe_tm_found_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    scope:oe_tm_seat1 = {
	        create_building_country_in_location = {
	            religion = c:BYZ.religion
	            culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
	            subject_type = subject_type:oe_empire_theme
	            overlord = c:BYZ
	            reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
	            hidden_effect = {
	                change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
	                change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect
	            }
	            save_scope_as = oe_tm_th1
	        }
	        construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble owner = scope:oe_tm_th1 cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
	    }
	    scope:oe_tm_th1 = {
	        if = { limit = { exists = ruler } ruler = { add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
	    }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	        add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_tm_th1
	        international_organization_add_special_status = { type = special_status:oe_pillars_theme country = scope:oe_tm_th1 }
	    }
	    # Historical name from the seat (gen_theme_names.py).
	    scope:oe_tm_seat1 = { save_scope_as = oe_theme_name_seat }
	    scope:oe_tm_th1 = { oe_theme_apply_name = yes }
	    scope:oe_tm_th1 = {
	        if = {
	            limit = { scope:oe_tm_seat1 = { has_variable = oe_theme_region } }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_region_id value = scope:oe_tm_seat1.var:oe_theme_region }
	            if = {
	                limit = { scope:oe_tm_seat1 = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_tier } }
	                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = scope:oe_tm_seat1.var:oe_theme_region_tier }
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    # The new country's capital link resolves to a location scope during this effect; use the seat itself.
	    scope:oe_tm_seat1 = {
	        while = { count = 3 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:oe_tm_th1 } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { is_coastal = yes }
	            while = { count = 6 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = n_cog owner = scope:oe_tm_th1 } }
	        }
	    }
	    scope:oe_tm_th1 = {
	        set_gold = 300
	        add_manpower = 3
	        # Origin mark: made from a subject kingdom (for the Roman-law integration and the frontier checks).
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_origin value = 1 }
	    }
	}
}

# Location scope. A post of province $n$; marks the province as a frontier when the location borders a country
# outside the Byzantine bloc.
oe_tm_post = {
    construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system owner = scope:oe_tm_th$n$ cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
    if = {
        limit = { any_neighbor_location = { has_owner = yes owner = { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        scope:oe_tm_th$n$ = { set_variable = oe_tm_front }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Status of the new province $n$: 2 frontier when it borders a foreign country, else 3 exarchate.
oe_tm_set_new_status = {
    scope:oe_tm_th$n$ = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_front }
            oe_ts_set_status = { status = 2 }
            remove_variable = oe_tm_front
        }
        else = { oe_ts_set_status = { status = 3 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Clears the marks of event oe_tm.1.
oe_tm_clear_new = {
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_1
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_2
    remove_variable = oe_tm_new_3
    remove_variable = oe_tm_old_ruler
}
# BYZ scope, yearly, AI Byzantium only.
oe_tm_ai_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_tm_prov_allowed = yes international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 30 } }
        random = {
            chance = 50
            random_subject = { limit = { oe_tm_prov_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tm_req }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_req } oe_tm_request = yes }
        }
    }
}

# ======================== alliance muster ========================
# BYZ scope. Contract: called at every campaign start, after the campaign wars exist (oe_hc_<r>_start).
oe_tm_alliance_muster = {
    hidden_effect = {
        every_subject = {
            limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tm_m_ans has_variable = oe_tm_m_ref has_variable = oe_tm_m_ref_added } }
            remove_variable = oe_tm_m_ans
            remove_variable = oe_tm_m_ref
            remove_variable = oe_tm_m_regs
            remove_variable = oe_tm_m_ref_added
        }
        remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_1 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_2 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_3 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_4 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_5 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_6 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_7 remove_variable = oe_tm_ma_8 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_1 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_2 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_3 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_4 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_5 remove_variable = oe_tm_mr_6
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_ans value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_ref value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_regs value = 0 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { oe_tm_muster_member = yes }
            save_scope_as = oe_tm_ally
            if = {
                limit = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < -50 } }
                random_list = { 75 = { oe_tm_muster_refuse = yes } 25 = { oe_tm_muster_answer = yes } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value < 0 } }
                random_list = { 40 = { oe_tm_muster_refuse = yes } 60 = { oe_tm_muster_answer = yes } }
            }
            else = { oe_tm_muster_answer = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_1 has_variable = oe_tm_mr_1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tm.4
        }
    }
}
# Subject scope (= scope:oe_tm_ally). Regiments by size at the capital, owned by the subject; joins the campaign.
oe_tm_muster_answer = {
    set_variable = oe_tm_m_ans
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { count >= 30 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_regs value = 3 }
        capital ?= { oe_hcr_units = { inf = 2 cav = 1 owner = oe_tm_ally } }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_regs add = 3 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { count >= 10 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_regs value = 2 }
        capital ?= { oe_hcr_units = { inf = 1 cav = 1 owner = oe_tm_ally } }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_regs add = 2 } }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_regs value = 1 }
        capital ?= { oe_hcr_units = { inf = 1 cav = 0 owner = oe_tm_ally } }
        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_regs add = 1 } }
    }
    oe_tm_join_campaign = yes
    c:BYZ = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_ans add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_1 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_2 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_3 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_4 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_5 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_6 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_6 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_7 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_7 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ma_8 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ma_8 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } }
    }
}
# Subject scope (= scope:oe_tm_ally). Opinion of BYZ -10; +5 years on its ladder, at most +15.
oe_tm_muster_refuse = {
    set_variable = oe_tm_m_ref
    c:BYZ = { reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tm_muster_refused target = scope:oe_tm_ally } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 15 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_ladder_extra } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_ladder_extra value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tm_ladder_extra add = 5 }
        set_variable = oe_tm_m_ref_added
    }
    c:BYZ = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_tm_m_n_ref add = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_1 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_2 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_3 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_3 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_4 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_5 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_5 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } } else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tm_mr_6 } } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_mr_6 value = scope:oe_tm_ally } }
    }
}
# Subject scope (= scope:oe_tm_ally). Joins every war of the running campaign it is not in yet.
oe_tm_join_campaign = {
    c:BYZ = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } every_current_war = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_war } oe_tm_join_war = yes } } }
}
# War scope.
oe_tm_join_war = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_in_war = scope:oe_tm_ally } }
        save_scope_as = oe_tm_war
        scope:oe_tm_ally = { join_war_with = { war = scope:oe_tm_war target = c:BYZ ignore_rules = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Event oe_tm.4 b: the refusers of this muster lose the +5 years again.
oe_tm_muster_pardon = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
	    every_subject = {
	        limit = { has_variable = oe_tm_m_ref_added }
	        change_variable = { name = oe_tm_ladder_extra add = -5 }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tm_ladder_extra ?= 0 } remove_variable = oe_tm_ladder_extra }
	        remove_variable = oe_tm_m_ref_added
	    }
	}
}

# ======================== tests (dev mod buttons) ========================
# BYZ scope. A random Roman ally becomes a provincialised subject.
oe_tm_test_promote = {
    random_subject = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub } change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_rome_sub_II }
}
# BYZ scope. Every provincialised subject: 120 months served and +100 opinion of BYZ (test bias).
oe_tm_test_ready = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II }
        save_scope_as = oe_tm_t
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_sub2_months value = 120 }
        c:BYZ = { reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tm_test_favour target = scope:oe_tm_t } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Saves a test target as scope:oe_tm_req: a valid one, else any provincialised subject or Egypt.
oe_tm_test_pick = {
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_tm_prov_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tm_req }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tm_req } }
        random_subject = { limit = { OR = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II is_subject_type = oe_sub_mam } } save_scope_as = oe_tm_req }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Provincialise at once, without the senate.
oe_tm_test_force = {
    oe_tm_test_pick = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_req } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_target value = scope:oe_tm_req } oe_tsn_apply_3 = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. Run the senate's rejection.
oe_tm_test_reject = {
    oe_tm_test_pick = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_req } set_variable = { name = oe_tm_target value = scope:oe_tm_req } oe_tsn_reject_3 = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. Every provincialised subject: 35 months of grudge and -100 opinion (test bias); oe_tm.3 next month.
oe_tm_test_sour = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { is_subject_type = oe_rome_sub_II }
        save_scope_as = oe_tm_t
        set_variable = { name = oe_tm_neg_months value = 35 }
        c:BYZ = { reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tm_test_grudge target = scope:oe_tm_t } }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_tm_dem_open
}
